title: CUSI Flores — services and contact
content: CUSI Flores is a premium floral studio in Ciudad de México. It offers bouquets, roses, tulips, Phalaenopsis orchids, floral arrangements, personalized gifts and event floral design. Orders and quotes: WhatsApp +52 55 2109 2665, https://wa.me/525521092665. Each order is confirmed by CUSI for flower availability, presentation, price, destination, date and schedule. Instagram: https://instagram.com/cusiflores.

title: Delivery and ordering
content: CUSI coordinates scheduled flower delivery in selected areas of Ciudad de México and its metropolitan area. Frequent areas include Lomas de Chapultepec, Bosques de las Lomas, Polanco, Santa Fe, Roma and Condesa. Ask CUSI to confirm destination coverage, the final delivery cost and the available delivery window. Same-day service depends on availability and must be confirmed with CUSI. Automatic road-distance pricing is not active on the public site. No chat action can confirm an order or accept payment.
